creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-3 stage 2, control plane. Lands in the same integration as a_2XJ1i5JiA and a_2XJ1iQGQ6; nothing ships with both backends.

`muster-daemon-client` replaces `muster-herdr` behind the core's backend traits (`BackendChannel` at `crates/muster-core/src/intent.rs:505`, `PaneChannel`, the event vocabulary in `mirror/`), reshaped to the new protocol. The seam's composition root (`crates/muster-seam/src/session.rs`) calls about a dozen herdr functions directly today (daemon reach/start/reload/stop, the subscription loop, snapshot fetch, quit-time sizes); those move behind the client.

What goes (MIP-3 section 14): rect-to-tree reconstruction, replay rejection and remembered removals, answer-before-broadcast settling, inferred tab closes, per-pane agent subscriptions, the name registry's backend binding, the workaround for herdr's 2 MiB cap, quit-time size hand-back, `find`/`viewport` on `BackendChannel`, `find.rs`, the scroll intent, the holding record's wait for a new tab's name, prompt polling before a command. The mirror applies events only; an answer tells the caller when its request took effect.

Also here: grouped tabs by membership on each daemon, region order and weights staying in the window arrangement, label generations (MIP-3 section 2).
title: Cut-over: the core and seam run on muster-daemon's events
